name: transfer_to_human
description: Transfer the live phone call to a Digit claims specialist. Call this AFTER log_escalation when someone is injured, the car was stolen, an FIR is needed, cover is disputed, the policy is expired and the caller still needs help, the API returned HUMAN_REQUIRED, there is no garage in city, or the caller clearly asks for a person. Do not transfer after a successful own-damage claim registration. Do not transfer merely because the caller paused or said hmm.
pre_call_message: I am connecting you to a specialist. Please stay on the line.

reason.description: Short reason for the transfer, for example injury reported or caller asked for a human.

summary.description: One-line summary of the conversation so the specialist has context.

call_sid.description: The live call id. Use {call_sid} when the system provides it.
